title: 第11章 轰杀第8章 一巴掌拍死
lines: 这骤然降临的黑袍身影，自然就是叶无缺。
他来到紫族附近后，就感知到了里面正在爆发的恐怖大战，并且还发现了紫阳神正在复活的神秘波动。
因此他瞬间进来驰援。
此刻，对于突然降临的叶无缺，君逍遥神情依旧没有多少变化，依旧是一副掌握一切的模样。
倒是君逍遥身后，一个高大身影一步踏出，死死盯着叶无缺。
正是君家第一序列，君长剑！
他冷冷道:
“是你！”
他死死盯着叶无缺，英俊而冷酷的脸庞因极致的愤怒而扭曲，双眼赤红如血，仿佛要喷出火来！
一股比之前更加狂暴、更加凶戾的祖神境后期气息，如同压抑到极致的火山，轰然爆发！
周围的空间都因这股气息而发出不堪重负的呻吟！
“是你……杀了我弟弟！
君长剑的声音如同受伤的凶兽在咆哮，每一个字都裹挟着刺骨的杀意和刻骨的恨意！
他终于找到了那个在遥远星域抹杀君短剑的凶手！
“蝼蚁！
我要你……死无葬身之地！
暴吼声中，君长剑手中光华暴涌！
一柄通体暗金、造型古朴的长剑骤然显现！
剑身流淌着如同岩浆般的暗金色纹路，散发出撕裂苍穹、斩灭星辰的绝世锋芒！
这正是他性命交修的本命神兵——裂穹剑！
没有丝毫犹豫，没有丝毫试探！
君长剑将祖神境后期的磅礴神力毫无保留地注入裂穹剑中！
“裂穹·陨星！
他双手持剑，人剑合一，化作一道撕裂虚空的暗金毁灭洪流！
剑光所过之处，空间如同脆弱的琉璃般寸寸崩裂，发出刺耳的哀鸣！
一道仿佛由无数陨星碎片凝聚而成的毁灭剑罡，带着碾碎万物的意志，瞬间跨越百丈距离，将叶无缺连同他所在的整片空间，彻底淹没！
轰隆隆——！
如同千百颗星辰同时炸裂！
刺目欲盲的暗金光芒吞噬了一切！
恐怖的能量冲击波如同灭世海啸般横扫而出，将附近激战的一些紫家、君家年轻弟子都狠狠掀飞出去，口喷鲜血！
大地被犁开深不见底的沟壑，虚空留下久久无法愈合的漆黑裂痕！
content_en:
The black-robed figure who suddenly appeared was naturally Ye Wuque.
When he came near the Purple Clan, he sensed the terrifying war that was breaking out inside, and also discovered the mysterious fluctuations of the Purple Sun God being resurrected.
So he came in instantly to help.
At this moment, Jun Xiaoyao's expression did not change much as Ye Wuque suddenly arrived, and he still looked like he was in control of everything.
Behind Jun Xiaoyao, a tall figure stepped forward and stared at Ye Wuque.
It is the first rank of the Jun family, Jun Changjian!
He said coldly:
"It's you!"
He stared at Ye Wuque, his handsome and cold face twisted with extreme anger, his eyes as red as blood, as if they were about to spit out fire!
An aura of late-stage Ancestral God Realm that was even more violent and ferocious than before, erupting like a volcano suppressed to the extreme!
The surrounding space groaned overwhelmed by this breath!
"It was you... who killed my brother!
! "
The sound of Jun's sword was like the roar of a wounded beast, and every word was packed with piercing murderous intent and deep-seated hatred!
He finally found the murderer who killed Jun Dagger in the distant star field!
"Ants!
I want you... to die without a burial place!
! "
Amid the violent roar, brilliance surged from the hand of Jun's sword!
A long sword with a dark gold body and a simple shape suddenly appeared!
The sword body is flowing with dark golden lines like lava, exuding a peerless edge that can tear the sky and annihilate the stars!
This is the divine weapon of his life--the Sky-Splitting Sword!
No hesitation, no temptation!
Jun Changjian unreservedly injects the majestic divine power of the late stage of the Ancestral God Realm into the Sky-Splitting Sword!
"Split Dome·Meteor!
! "
He held swords in both hands, and the human sword merged into one, turning into a torrent of dark gold destruction that tore through the void!
Wherever the sword light passed, the space cracked inch by inch like fragile glass, letting out a harsh wail!
A destructive sword that seemed to be condensed from countless meteor fragments, with the will to crush everything, instantly spanned a distance of a hundred feet, completely submerging Ye Wuque and the entire space where he was!
Rumble——!
Like thousands of stars exploding at the same time!
The blinding dark golden light swallowed everything!
The terrifying energy shock wave swept out like a world-destroying tsunami, sending some of the young disciples of the Zi family and Jun family who were fighting fiercely away, spitting blood from their mouths!
The earth was plowed into bottomless ravines, leaving dark cracks in the void that could not be healed for a long time!
